notes: §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR1: 'The successful execution of an OPEN statement determines the availability of the file and results in the file being in an open mode', with Table 1 giving 'Normal open' for every available file and, for an unavailable one, unsuccessful (INPUT, I-O, EXTEND), created (OUTPUT, optional I-O, optional EXTEND) or a normal open whose first read gives at end or invalid key (optional INPUT). KeyedConnector.OpenCore implements Table 1 for a relative file (05 for an absent optional file, 35 for an absent mandatory one, creation on OUTPUT and optional I-O/EXTEND), FileConnector.OptionalAbsent drives the first read's 10/23, and the 1985 edition arm is FileRegistry.SharedOpenAttempt: Table 19 arbitration runs only when FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect (2002 on), so at 85 every open of an available file is a normal open. Probes at --std 85 (classes c, e): two RELATIVE connectors (DYNAMIC and RANDOM) on one physical file both open I-O (00) and the second reads the first's record, and INPUT while the other is I-O is 00, whereas at --std 2002 the same program gives 61 (the edition arm); a re-OPEN of an open file 41; OPTIONAL RANDOM INPUT absent 05 and its first READ invalid key 23; mandatory I-O absent 35 and the READ after that failed OPEN 47; OPTIONAL DYNAMIC I-O absent 05, a WRITE creates the record and it reads back (00). The witness walks Table 1's seven rows for sequential-access relative files with USE procedures on the unsuccessful ones (35).

next.reason: Availability, open mode and the connector association match, and Table 18 repeats 1985 Table 1 entry for entry (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR4, with GR13, GR17, GR18 restating the optional-input, creation and empty-output entries). But 1985 Table 1 gives 'Normal open' for every available file (§1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR1), while 2023 limits Table 18 to files not open elsewhere and adds Table 19, which 'shows the results of opening available files that are currently open by another file connector' with many 'Unsuccessful open' cells; with no SHARING phrase 'the implementor shall define the sharing mode' (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR23). An available file with insufficient authority also fails ('37', §2023:14.9.27.4 GR3). A 1985 program opening a file already open through another connector can now fail.
